spec.description: k6 performance dashboard on raw k6 metrics · Test overview, errors, load, latency, request breakdown, and run history.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> group(columns: ["name", "method"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${latency_window}, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column, method: "estimate_tdigest"), createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> group(columns: ["name", "method"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${latency_window}, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.99, column: column, method: "estimate_tdigest"), createEmpty: false)

runs = from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vus" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_name == "${test_name}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> group(columns: ["test_id"])

starts = runs
  |> first()
  |> keep(columns: ["test_id", "_time"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "run_start"})

ends = runs
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["test_id", "_time"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "run_end"})

join(tables: {s: starts, e: ends}, on: ["test_id"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      test_id: r.test_id,
      run_start: r.run_start,
      run_end: r.run_end,
      duration_sec: float(v: int(v: r.run_end) - int(v: r.run_start)) / 1000000000.0,
      // Requests can land up to ~1s outside the first/last vus sample; 5s keeps every request in range.
      from_ms: int(v: r.run_start) / 1000000 - 5000,
      to_ms: int(v: r.run_end) / 1000000 + 5000
  }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["run_start"], desc: true)

spec.description: All runs for the selected Test Name and Env, newest first. Click a run to select the run and set its time range. Pagination enabled.
spec.title: Test run history

spec.query:
import "strings"

// Per-request statistics for the selected run.
base = from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["name", "method"])

failures = from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed" and r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["name", "method"])

// Two-digit prefixes set the column order (pivot keeps the order it meets columns in); they are stripped at the end.
pct = (q, label) => base |> quantile(q: q, column: "_value", method: "estimate_tdigest") |> set(key: "_field", value: label)

total = base |> count(column: "_value") |> set(key: "_field", value: "01 Total") |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
// Summing failure values preserves a zero-valued KO column for successful requests.
ko = failures |> sum(column: "_value") |> set(key: "_field", value: "02 KO")
pctKo = failures |> mean(column: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 100.0})) |> set(key: "_field", value: "03 % KO")
minimum = base |> min(column: "_value") |> set(key: "_field", value: "05 min")
maximum = base |> max(column: "_value") |> set(key: "_field", value: "10 max")

// Throughput is based on the observed time span of each request series.
firstTimes = base |> first() |> keep(columns: ["name", "method", "_time"]) |> rename(columns: {_time: "first_time"})
lastTimes = base |> last() |> keep(columns: ["name", "method", "_time"]) |> rename(columns: {_time: "last_time"})
spans = join(tables: {first: firstTimes, last: lastTimes}, on: ["name", "method"])
counts = base |> count(column: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["name", "method", "_value"])
rps = join(tables: {span: spans, counts: counts}, on: ["name", "method"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if int(v: r.last_time) > int(v: r.first_time) then float(v: r._value) * 1000000000.0 / float(v: int(v: r.last_time) - int(v: r.first_time)) else 0.0}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "04 RPS")

union(tables: [total, rps, ko, pctKo, minimum, pct(q: 0.50, label: "06 p50"), pct(q: 0.90, label: "07 p90"), pct(q: 0.95, label: "08 p95"), pct(q: 0.99, label: "09 p99"), maximum])
  |> keep(columns: ["name", "method", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_field"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["name", "method"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["method"])
  |> rename(fn: (column) => if column == "name" then "Name" else if column =~ /^[0-9]{2} / then strings.substring(v: column, start: 3, end: strings.strlen(v: column)) else column)
  // Busiest endpoints first.
  |> sort(columns: ["Total", "Name"], desc: true)

spec.title: Errors breakdown
spec.description: Every request / HTTP status / k6 error code combination that failed: how many times, share of that request's calls, first and last occurrence.

spec.query:
// Which errors happened, how many, on which request, and when.
describe = (code, status) =>
  if code == "n/a" then (if status == "0" then "Network error" else "HTTP ${status}")
  else if code == "1000" then "Generic error"
  else if code == "1010" then "Non-TCP network error"
  else if code == "1020" then "Invalid URL"
  else if code == "1050" then "Request timeout"
  else if code == "1100" then "DNS error"
  else if code == "1101" then "DNS: no IP for host"
  else if code == "1200" then "TCP error"
  else if code == "1201" then "TCP: broken pipe"
  else if code == "1210" then "TCP dial error"
  else if code == "1211" then "TCP dial timeout"
  else if code == "1212" then "Connection refused"
  else if code == "1220" then "Connection reset by peer"
  else if code =~ /^13/ then "TLS error"
  else if code =~ /^14/ then "HTTP 4xx - client error"
  else if code =~ /^15/ then "HTTP 5xx - server error"
  else if code =~ /^16/ then "HTTP/2 error"
  else "k6 error " + code

failed = from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
      status: if exists r.status then r.status else "0",
      error_code: if exists r.error_code then r.error_code else "n/a"
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["name", "method", "status", "error_code"])

totals = from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_reqs" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> group(columns: ["name", "method"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({name: r.name, method: r.method, requests: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group()

errors = failed |> count() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)})) |> set(key: "_field", value: "errors")
firstSeen = failed |> first() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: int(v: r._time) / 1000000)})) |> set(key: "_field", value: "first_seen")
lastSeen = failed |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: int(v: r._time) / 1000000)})) |> set(key: "_field", value: "last_seen")

stats = union(tables: [errors, firstSeen, lastSeen])
  |> keep(columns: ["name", "method", "status", "error_code", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["name", "method", "status", "error_code"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

join(tables: {s: stats, t: totals}, on: ["name", "method"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      "Request": "[" + r.method + "] " + r.name,
      "Status": r.status,
      "Error code": r.error_code,
      "Error": describe(code: r.error_code, status: r.status),
      "Count": r.errors,
      "% of request calls": if r.requests > 0.0 then r.errors / r.requests * 100.0 else 0.0,
      "First seen": r.first_seen,
      "Last seen": r.last_seen
  }))
  |> sort(columns: ["Count"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vus" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> group()
  |> max()

Response time distribution
spec.description: Requests of the run by response time: faster than Fast, ms, between Fast and Slow, and slower than Slow, ms. Failures are in the KO columns of Request Statistics.

spec.query:
import "array"

fastMs = float(v: ${fast_ms})
slowMs = float(v: ${slow_ms})

counts = from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      bucket: if r._value < fastMs then "fast" else if r._value <= slowMs then "medium" else "slow",
      n: 1
  }))

// Zero rows keep every bucket present; order sets the column (and bar) order.
zeros = array.from(rows: [
    {bucket: "fast", n: 0},
    {bucket: "medium", n: 0},
    {bucket: "slow", n: 0},
])
order = (b) => if b == "fast" then 1 else if b == "medium" then 2 else 3

// One row, one column per bucket: both the bar chart and the pie chart colour series by column name.
union(tables: [counts, zeros])
  |> group(columns: ["bucket"])
  |> sum(column: "n")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({x: "Requests", bucket: r.bucket, n: r.n, o: order(b: r.bucket)}))
  |> sort(columns: ["o"])
  |> drop(columns: ["o"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["x"], columnKey: ["bucket"], valueColumn: "n")

spec.title: Share of requests
spec.description: Share of each response-time bucket. Data comes from Response time distribution (no extra InfluxDB query).

spec.query:
// Raw samples are read once; every series below is derived from them in memory.
data = from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value"])

windowSec = float(v: int(v: ${latency_window})) / 1000000000.0
pct = (q) => (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: q, column: column, method: "estimate_tdigest")
series = (fn, name, order) => data
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${latency_window}, fn: fn, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: name)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with order: order}))

// Every request has exactly one http_req_duration sample, so their count per window is the request rate.
rps = data
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${latency_window}, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / windowSec}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "rps")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with order: 0}))

// One column per series, so Grafana names each field after it. pivot() creates columns in the order it meets them:
// rps first so its bars are drawn under the lines, then the legend order avg, p95, p99.
union(tables: [rps, series(fn: mean, name: "avg", order: 1), series(fn: pct(q: 0.95), name: "p95", order: 2), series(fn: pct(q: 0.99), name: "p99", order: 3)])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value", "order"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["order", "_time"])
  |> drop(columns: ["order"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vus" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${latency_window}, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

spec.description: Response time of all requests (left axis) against the load: requests per second (bars) and virtual users (dashed), both on the right axis. RPS and VUs are not in the legend, so they stay visible when you click a latency series. Latency growing with load shows where the system saturates.
spec.title: Latency vs load

spec.query:
windowSec = float(v: int(v: ${latency_window})) / 1000000000.0

// One read of http_req_failed: each response is OK (0) or KO (1); count them per window and turn counts into a rate.
from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.test_id == "${test_id}" and r.env == "${env}")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time, _value: r._value, result: if r._value > 0.0 then "KO" else "OK"}))
  |> group(columns: ["result"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${latency_window}, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, result: r.result, _value: float(v: r._value) / windowSec}))
  |> group()
  // OK first, so it is the bottom of the stack and KO sits on top.
  |> sort(columns: ["result", "_time"], desc: true)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["result"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
